command:
set -eu; BASE=/workspace/omega_runtime; git -C "$BASE/carrier_repo" fetch origin omega-vps-deploy omega-master-control omega-master-results-v1 chatgpt-local-ai-core-node-control chatgpt-local-ai-core-node-results chatgpt-local-andreas-maco-control chatgpt-local-andreas-maco-results; git -C "$BASE/carrier_repo" checkout -B omega-vps-deploy origin/omega-vps-deploy; SHA=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
print(json.load(open('/workspace/omega_runtime/carrier_repo/omega_deploy/LATEST.json'))['omega_head'])
PY
); SRC="$BASE/carrier_repo/omega_deploy/$SHA"; REL="$BASE/releases/$SHA"; mkdir -p "$REL"; cp -a "$SRC/." "$REL/"; ln -sfn "$REL" "$BASE/current"; python3 - <<PY
import json,datetime,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('$BASE/CURRENT_RELEASE.json'); p.write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'OMEGA_CURRENT_RELEASE/v1','omega_head':'$SHA','release_path':'$REL','activated_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'carrier_branch':'omega-vps-deploy'},indent=2)+'\n')
PY
cd "$REL"; echo OMEGA_RELEASE=$SHA; python3 -m compileall -q omega tests; python3 -m pytest -q; PYTHONPATH="$REL" python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
from omega.unified_store import UnifiedStore
s=UnifiedStore(Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/data/omega_unified.db'),Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/current/schema')); s.register_sources(json.load(open('/workspace/omega_runtime/current/config/sources.json'))['sources'])
with s.connect() as c:
 print('UNIFIED_TABLES',len(c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall())); print('SOURCES',c.execute('select count(*) from source_subject').fetchone()[0])
PY
export PYTHONPATH="$REL" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$REL" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$BASE/state" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$BASE/data/omega_unified.db" OMEGA_CARRIER_REPO="$BASE/carrier_repo" OMEGA_ROUTER_CONFIG="$REL/config/organ_router.json" OMEGA_AUTONOMY_POLICY="$REL/config/autonomy_policy.json"; python3 -m omega.telemetry_daemon --once; python3 -m omega.grid_runtime_v3 --once; python3 -m omega.bridge_relay --once; python3 -m omega.master_bridge_carrier --once; echo '--- TELEMETRY ---'; for f in "$BASE/state/telemetry"/*.json; do echo ===$f===; cat "$f"; done; echo '--- GRID ---'; cat "$BASE/state/STATUS.json"; echo '--- MASTER SUBMITTED ---'; find "$BASE/state/master_bridge/submitted" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' 2>/dev/null | tail -n 5; echo '=== OMEGA ACCEPTANCE PASS ==='
